newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil see-saws with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil see-saws with futures.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices moved with volatile crude futures on Tuesday, traders said.
One player said a Swedish utility had bought an M-100 cargo but the price of the deal was not known.
Various other cargoes loading in the first week of September were heard offered by Russian traders.

An Irish low sulphur straight-run cargo was heard sold to a trader late on Monday. One refiner said he thought the price of the deal was $128 fob NWE. This was not confirmed. But bids and offer numbers on Tuesday were, in some cases, $10 a tonne apart.
